cells.label: fact

items.text: Schwab's CEO said that over the longer term the firm believes AI will meaningfully enhance the way it serves clients and allow it to reach clients in an even more personalized way.
items.quote: Over the longer term, we believe AI will meaningfully enhance the way we serve our clients and allow us to reach our clients in an even more personalized way.

items.text: Schwab's CEO said AI can help create personalized and deeper relationships with clients the firm cannot currently serve at scale with one-to-one relationships, and described the rollout of an AI-enabled 'portfolio insights' experience delivering tailored insights to clients.
items.quote: AI can help us create personalized and deeper relationships with the clients we can't currently serve at scale with one-to-one relationships. We know investors are using AI today. 77% of U.S. investors use AI today, though more than 90% still prefer human involvement in addition to AI.

items.text: Bank of America's CFO said new AI-enabled tools help advisers prepare for client conversations, identify opportunities and deliver more personalized advice at scale.
items.quote: new AI-enabled tools that help advisers prepare for client conversations, identify opportunities and deliver more personalized advice at scale

items.text: Schwab's CEO said the firm's greatest advantage comes from combining people with AI-powered capabilities to create deeper relationships that scale with clients' needs, and that AI will personalize client experiences and journeys.
items.quote: we believe our greatest advantage comes from combining people with AI-powered capabilities to create deeper relationships that scale with our clients' needs. AI will help us attract new clients, deliver new capabilities to them, personalize more journeys, and create more opportunities to deepen relationships over time.

items.text: Raymond James' CEO said AI will not replace advisers but that advisers who use AI will replace those who do not, because AI saves time on administrative work and lets advisers spend more time developing personal relationships with clients.
items.quote: We say to our advisers, AI will not replace advisers. Advisers who use AI will replace advisers who do not use AI.

items.text: Schwab's CEO said clients engage in person, on the phone, via web, mobile, or via AI depending on the activity and stage of life, and that the firm brings an experience combining people and the power of AI across every channel.
items.quote: At different times in their lives and for different activities, clients engage with us in person, on the phone, web, mobile, or via AI. Our clients value that flexibility.

items.text: Schwab's investor day materials describe leveraging AI to allow reps to focus on deepening relationships and building 'pre-advice' experiences to anticipate advice needs.
items.quote: Leverage AI to allow reps to focus on deepening relationships ... 'Pre-advice' experiences to anticipate advice needs

items.text: Capgemini's World Wealth Report states that AI-powered next-best actions aligned to client goals enable personalized experiences at scale and that firms can engage clients proactively and deepen relationships through real-time intelligence.
items.quote: AI-powered next-best actions aligned to client goals enable personalized experiences at scale, demonstrate value beyond investment returns, and build the trust that keeps high-net-worth clients engaged.

items.text: Capgemini's World Wealth Report states that future relationship managers will need to deliver holistic wealth advice to a broader client base, moving from reactive, product-centric interactions toward more intentional, coordinated engagement.
items.quote: future relationship managers will need to deliver holistic wealth advice to a broader client base, and addressing this shift requires transformation across multiple fronts. Firms need to redefine how relationship managers engage with clients - moving away from predominantly reactive, product-centric interactions and toward more intentional, coordinated engagement.

items.text: InvestmentNews, discussing Edward Jones' minority stake in Quicken, states technology can support deeper conversations with clients and help clients be more proactively and productively engaged in the advice process when their finances are better organized automatically year-round.
items.quote: technology can support deeper conversations with clients when software helps to ensure their finances are better organized, automatically, year-round. Because advisors no longer have the bottleneck of struggling to deliver planning advice in the absence of clear data about the client's financial situation, and clients themselves can be more proactively and productively engaged in the advice process.

items.text: A trade press report quotes Nevis' founder predicting advisors will have hundreds of AI agents supporting them with a broad range of client services, including building wealth and estate plans, filing taxes, opening accounts and moving money.
items.quote: I think advisors will have literally hundreds of agents supporting them with a broad range of services to clients. You will have agents that build wealth and estate plans, agents that will file taxes on behalf of clients. You will have agents that are opening custody accounts and moving money.

cells.reason: Multiple passages across firms contain forward-looking statements about how AI, digital channels, and technology are expected to change the client advice experience, so these are facts.
